title: Boundary wall abutting an existing or simultaneously constructed wall
text: C3.4.5 Where the boundary wall abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension, that boundary wall may exceed the provisions of C3.4.4 up to the extent of height and length of the existing boundary wall.

replaces.note: concurrent-subdivision interfacing walls limb has no equivalent (C4P1-096)

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.5. Applied mechanically as a not_applicable exception on every C3.4.4 height and length rule (building.boundary_walls.adjoining_wall_exists); whether the wall stays within the existing wall's height and length is a planner check.
